why: Prices the harness is willing to state, in USD per million tokens. This
file is the ONLY source INV-5.cost will price a request from. A model that
is not listed here is UNPRICED: the harness saw the request, counted its
tokens off the provider's own usage block, and declines to invent a price
That is not a gap, it is the failure condition. When the harness has
unpriced traffic and the product shows the user '$0.00', INV-5.cost FAILS —
the product is telling the user they spent nothing when nobody knows what
they spent. Deleting entries from this file makes the check STRICTER, never
weaker, so there is no incentive to pad it with guesses.
Add a model only with a price you can point at a published rate card for,
